29514.d: Wendlewick is the largest settlement on Havenhythe, located on the west coast of the region.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
Getting to Wendlewick for the first time requires starting and progressing through the Visions of Havenhythe quest, started at the Rusty Anchor tavern in Port Sarim. During the quest, Wendlewick is travelled from Port Sarim via Captain Lorris. After completing the quest, the following become available as well:
• Use the Wendlewick lodestone or the Wendlewick Teleport or tablet
• Fairy ring Fairy code | BKS and head north

29515.d: The Wendlewick bank is the bank in the centre of Wendlewick.

29516.d: The Wendlewick Deserted Mine is a mine at the Deserted Mine in the south of Havenhythe.

29517.d: Wendlewick fish farm is located on the docks west of Wendlewick.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
• Use the Wendlewick lodestone, the Wendlewick Teleport, or the Wendlewick teleport (item). Then, run west.
• Run south from the dock Captain Lorris brings players from Port Sarim.
• Run west from the canoe station stop [Chat: 1 Wendlewick (Burnt Lobster Tavern)] if coming from another canoe station.

There are only a few ways to enter West Ardougne, with some of them only available during specific quests.
• Through the main door in the West Ardougne eastern wall after the Biohazard quest.
• Use the Ardougne lodestone and run south and west across the river.
• Use a spirit tree to teleport to the Khazard battlefield and run north and enter West Ardougne through the wall
• Use the Ardougne Teleport to arrive in the East Ardougne centre and run west across the river and around the castle.
• Use Kandarin monastery Teleport (requires unlocking Ardougne cloak 1) to teleport to the Ardougne Monastery and run north-west across the river.
• Breaking a 'Chipped' Ardougne teleport to arrive just south-east of the main doors of the Civic Office of West Ardougne. Requires the completion of Plague City, Evil Dave's Big Day Out and 51 Magic.
• Through the pipeline in the sewers under Edmond's house after the partial completion of the Plague City quest. This way becomes inaccessible after the Biohazard quest is started.
• Talking to Omart near the southern end of the eastern wall during the Biohazard quest. After the quest the passage over the wall can be used only from West to East Ardougne by talking to Kilron. The wall cannot be passed this way anymore after Plague's End.
• Through the Underground Pass from Tirannwn. Requires starting Regicide.
• Using a crystal teleport seed or its attuned version to teleport to the Temple of Light. Run east of through the Mourner tunnels and climb the ladder to Mourner Headquarters. Requires the completion of Within the Light.

29543.d: Whale's Maw is an island in the Arc region of the Wushanko Isles.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
• Players can travel to Whale's Maw by using the Arc Journal teleport to Port Sarim and then talking to Quartermaster Gully. He can also be spoken to in Menaphos.
• Whale's Maw teleport tablet, purchased from the Waiko Reward Shop.
